title: The Earth's interior
back: Crust (30–40 km land, 5–7 km ocean) → mantle → liquid outer core → solid inner core. Lithosphere = crust + upper mantle.

title: Cold Milk, Orange Ice-cream
back: Outside in: crust, mantle, outer core (liquid), inner core (solid).

title: What moves the plates
back: Core heat → hot mantle rises → spreads → cools and sinks: convection currents drag plates a few cm a year.

title: Three plate boundaries
back: Convergent: collide (Himalaya) · Divergent: apart, new crust (Mid-Atlantic Ridge) · Transform: slide past (San Andreas).

title: The Ring of Fire

back: Belt of frequent earthquakes and volcanoes around the Pacific Ocean, along plate boundaries.

title: Weathering vs erosion
back: Weathering: physical, chemical, biological; starts soil. Erosion: running water, wind, glaciers, waves carry material away.

title: How an oxbow lake forms
back: Bend → outer bank eroded, inner bank deposited → neck narrows → river cuts through in a flood, loop left as an oxbow lake.

title: Cave → arch → stack
back: Waves hollow a cave in a headland, caves break through as an arch, the arch roof collapses leaving a stack.

title: River valley vs glacial valley
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 260 130" role="img" aria-label="V-shaped river valley beside a U-shaped glacial valley" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M10,20L60,100L110,20"/><path class="u" d="M150,20V60Q150,100 200,100Q250,100 250,60V20"/><path stroke="#E0B400" d="M56,96Q60,90 64,96"/><g font-size="13" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle"><text x="60" y="122">river: V</text><text x="200" y="122">glacier: U</text></g></svg>
back: Rivers cut narrow V-shaped valleys; glaciers grind wide U-shaped valleys and leave moraines.

title: Inside a karst cave
back: Groundwater dissolves limestone: sinkholes, caves, stalactites (ceiling), stalagmites (ground), pillars. Borra Caves, Meghalaya.

title: Stalactite or stalagmite?
back: They grow drop by drop and join as a pillar.

title: How a GLOF happens
back: Glacier melts → lake behind a weak debris dam → dam bursts (rain, quake, landslide) → sudden flood downstream.

title: Saving soil on a slope
back: Hold rainwater, slow runoff, trap sediment, recharge groundwater. Nagaland's Zabo system uses earthen bunds.
